rationale_summary: Pure free ≥ 20% is not a meaningful primary safety criterion on macOS Apple Silicon: healthy systems routinely show pure free < 2% while reclaimable memory and Darwin free% remain adequate.
LocalModelHarness already does not implement pure free — free_percent is reclaimable (free+inactive+speculative)/RAM. Operator/docs language conflated pure free with this field.
M370 intended min_free_memory_percent=20 against Darwin memory_pressure free%, plus reclaimable MiB floor — not pure free pages.
Absolute 1024 MiB reclaimable floor alone is insufficient for qwen2.5:1.5b peak estimates; headroom must scale with estimated model peak × safety factor.
Combined fail-closed gate required: Darwin free% floor, reclaimable vs model budget, swap bounds, single session, single loaded model, probe failure fail-closed.

current_host_application_of_proposed_gat.note: Gate correctly blocks load on current host with apps open even though pure-free narrative and simple 1024 MiB floor disagree.
